create.title: Compact beta support annihilates every transferred radial-side stratum
create.statement_tex: Fix the actual even mask psi in C_c^infinity(R), with psi=1 on [-B0,B0] and supp psi subset [-2B0,2B0]. On either reflected renormalized radial side Im(s)=plus or minus S and throughout |Im u|<=U, |Im v|<=V, beta=Im(s)-(Im u+Im v)/2 satisfies |beta|>=S-(U+V)/2. Hence if S>(U+V)/2+2B0, psi and all derivatives vanish on an open neighborhood of the full side product. Every one of the sixteen finite beta two-axis transfer strata is therefore identically zero: pure faces/axes/corner carry psi, connector faces/axes carry psi'/2, and the mixed product area carries psi''/4. Axis restrictions improve the separation; artificial and arithmetic collision equations lie outside the box. This is exact finite support separation and is scoped only to the beta-masked radial-side vector.
create.next_action: Use this exact-zero lemma only for the frozen compact beta branch and separated radial sides; do not apply it to endpoint/arithmetic physical modules or noncompact masks.

update.statement_tex: For the fixed compact beta mask, the complete sixteen-stratum two-axis transfer commutes with the accepted nested removal of renormalized radial sides. reject.reason: For S>(U+V)/2+2B0, the compact beta mask and all derivatives vanish identically on the radial-side product. Every transferred stratum is zero before any R_M estimate, so M=1 suffices.
Exact annihilation uses compact support. A merely decaying mask would require the unproved uniform derivative, residue, collision, and area estimates originally listed in the round brief.
Endpoint and R1 arithmetic physical modules are not radial-side-supported at Im(s)=plus or minus S; the beta support gap gives no control of their symmetric physical-profile limits.
Only the compact beta share vanishes by support. The complementary hierarchical masks need not vanish; their global sum is handled by the already accepted unmasked radial-side module.
